description: Use this when a user asks about prediction markets or wants to research the conditions, deadlines or settlement risks behind a forecast about politics, elections, a ceasefire, economics, crypto or sport, even without naming Scanverity or providing a URL. Search by a short topic keyword, usually in English, such as "ceasefire", "inflation" or "Bitcoin". Returns specific Polymarket contract IDs, questions, deadlines and source links; outcomes appear when the global registry supplies them. If the global registry is unavailable, a fresh tracked high-volume subset may be returned with an explicit limited result_scope and no outcomes. An empty subset never proves market absence. Free discovery: no report, payment or allowance consumption. Not general news search, live odds, a probability forecast or a trading recommendation. Verify the exact contract before a separately authorized assessment.

cursor.description: Exact next_cursor from the previous page with the same query, dates and limit. An empty truncated page is not proof of absence.

end_date_from.description: Earliest scheduled end date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today UTC. Only active rows from the available identity source.

end_date_to.description: Latest scheduled end date, YYYY-MM-DD; set when the user specifies a horizon.

limit.description: Maximum contracts on this page, default 5.

query.description: A short topic or keyword from the user question; omit personal information. Prefer English market wording. Do not pass a full URL or a long conversational prompt.

name: scanverity_search_markets
title: Find prediction markets for a topic or question
